page.meta_description: Searching for Roblox Stand Out codes? No public codes are listed yet—here's the code status, controls, beginner tips, and game facts.
page.tagline: A bizarre Roblox adventure with a teased code drop—here's the honest code status and how to play.
overview: Stand Out is a Roblox game from Studio Umbra: Europa, described on its Roblox page as "a game about a bizarre adventure." It supports up to 18 players per server and lists Roblox platform support for PC, Mac, mobile, tablet, Xbox, PlayStation, and VR.

If you're here for Roblox Stand Out codes, the game page does not list any active codes at the time of writing. The description does tease a future drop with "NEXT CODE AT 100K LIKES!" That suggests codes may be tied to community milestones, but no redeemable code or redemption instructions are published in the provided source.

The page has drawn 6,163,345 visits and showed 32,439 players online when this was written. It was created on July 16, 2025. The control list is already detailed, including run, light and heavy attacks, block, dash, camera lock, pilot mode, summon, and pose.

how_to_play: Open the official Roblox page for Stand Out and launch the experience.
Set up your controls: Left Shift (or W+W) to run, Left Mouse Button for light attack, R for heavy attack, F to block, and Q to dash.
Use Left Alt to lock the camera and Left Control for pilot mode when you need those views.
Use E to summon and P to pose. These are listed on the game page alongside the combat controls.
Join a server with up to 18 players and start exploring the game's "bizarre adventure."
Watch the game description for the next code milestone—it says the next code comes at 100K likes.
tips: Learn dash (Q) early—it's your quick repositioning tool.
Block with F when you're under pressure instead of trading hits.
Use Left Alt camera lock to keep your target centered during fights.
W+W is listed as an alternate run input if Left Shift isn't comfortable.
The game supports mobile, tablet, console, and VR, but the published controls are keyboard/mouse; check Roblox's input mapping on your device.
There are no public codes to redeem yet; keep an eye on the page's 100K-likes code tease rather than trusting random code lists.
